final: WITH city_counts AS (SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS addr_count FROM address GROUP BY city_id), avg_of_counts AS (SELECT AVG(addr_count) AS avg_addr_count FROM city_counts), sum_of_counts AS (SELECT SUM(addr_count) AS total_addr_count FROM city_counts), paired_with_avg AS (SELECT cc.city_id, cc.addr_count, cc.addr_count / CAST(aa.avg_addr_count AS FLOAT) AS count_div_avg FROM city_counts cc CROSS JOIN avg_of_counts aa WHERE aa.avg_addr_count IS NOT NULL), final_with_total AS (SELECT pwa.city_id, pwa.addr_count, pwa.count_div_avg, pwa.addr_count / CAST(sc.total_addr_count AS FLOAT) AS count_div_total FROM paired_with_avg pwa CROSS JOIN sum_of_counts sc WHERE sc.total_addr_count IS NOT NULL) SELECT city_id, addr_count, count_div_avg, count_div_total FROM final_with_total ORDER BY count_div_total IS NULL, count_div_total DESC LIMIT 10
